description: In the year to September 2026, sugar cost 29.8% more across India and jaggery 22.6% more, against 7.7% for all food (MoSPI's Consumer Price Index, provisional).

Ready-made sweets rose 9.4%, both those made with milk and those without. Ghee rose 3.7% and liquid milk 4.2%. Sugar rose about three times as much as ready-made sweets. The map shows the food price rise in every state (Consumer Food Price Index). These are all-India prices for September 2026 against September 2025, not festival-week prices. MoSPI cautions that state-level indices may rest on thin samples of price quotations. September's figures are provisional and will be revised with October's release on 12 November.

done: Every figure is read from MoSPI's all-India item table (read 15 Oct 2026 and re-read 16 Oct: all 637 rows match) and tested by the builder; the name of every item code is checked, and any figure typed into a card must be one the story reads from a table.

Numbers editor (independent) re-read the items and 23 states of each closing map live at MoSPI: no mismatch. Viewer editor: the hook, title and top bar now give the period and 'provisional', so the figures are not read as festival-week prices.
Our own finding is tested: sugar's rise is 3.18 times milk sweets' and 3.16 times other sweets'.
